descriptor: Calm workspace for drafts and launches

voice.summary: Modulo speaks in compact, balanced lines, the way its cards sit in a grid. It claims little, shows a lot, and trusts the product demo to carry the weight.
dos: Pair every claim with a visible example
Keep headlines to two short lines
Write for people who already know what a good tool feels like
donts: Do not stack adjectives on one feature
Never explain a card that explains itself

taglines: Everything you need. Nothing you don't
The right tools in the right places
From first draft to final launch
boilerplate: Modulo is a modular workspace that brings chat, charts and integrations into one fast, quiet interface, from the first draft to the final launch.
